reading: Ukraine's leader, Mr. Zelensky, went to Washington.
He wants to talk with Mr. Trump.
Mr. Zelensky hopes to get more air defences.
These are systems to protect Ukraine from missiles.
Russia has escalated its attacks on Ukraine.
These attacks have been very dangerous and caused deadly attacks.
Ukraine needs strong commitments from the US.
These commitments mean the US promises to help.
Mr. Zelensky wants to make sure the help is firm.
So, Ukraine can protect its people better.

vocabulary.definition: A person who guides or commands a group.
Systems that protect a country from attacks by planes or missiles in the sky.
Strong promises to do something or give something.
Became more intense, larger, or more serious.
Violent actions that can cause death or serious harm.
weapons that fly through the air to hit a target

entries.ja: グループを導いたり、指揮したりする人。
entries.zh-Hans: 引导或指挥一个团体的人。
entries.es: Una persona que guía o dirige un grupo.
entries.pt-BR: Uma pessoa que guia ou comanda um grupo.

entries.ja: 空中にいる飛行機やミサイルからの攻撃から国を守るシステム。
entries.ko: 하늘에 있는 비행기나 미사일 공격으로부터 한 나라를 보호하는 시스템.
entries.zh-Hans: 保护一个国家免受空中飞机或导弹袭击的系统。
entries.es: Sistemas que protegen a un país de ataques de aviones o misiles en el cielo.
entries.pt-BR: Sistemas que protegem um país de ataques de aviões ou mísseis no céu.

entries.ja: 何かをする、あるいは何かを与えるという強い約束。
entries.ko: 어떤 일을 하거나 무엇을 주겠다는 강력한 약속.
entries.zh-Hans: 做出某事或给予某物的坚定承诺。
entries.es: Promesas firmes de hacer o dar algo.
entries.pt-BR: Promessas fortes de fazer ou dar algo.

entries.ja: より激しく、より大きく、またはより深刻になった。
entries.ko: 더 강렬해지거나, 더 커지거나, 더 심각해졌다.
entries.zh-Hans: 变得更激烈、更大或更严重。
entries.es: Se volvió más intenso, grande o serio.
entries.pt-BR: Tornou-se mais intenso, maior ou mais grave.

entries.ja: 死や深刻な危害を引き起こす可能性のある暴力的な行動。
entries.ko: 사망이나 심각한 해를 초래할 수 있는 폭력적인 행동.
entries.zh-Hans: 可能导致死亡或严重伤害的暴力行为。
entries.es: Acciones violentas que pueden causar la muerte o daños graves.
entries.pt-BR: Ações violentas que podem causar morte ou danos graves.

entries.ja: 標的を攻撃するために空を飛ぶ武器。
entries.ko: 표적을 맞히기 위해 공중을 날아가는 무기.
entries.zh-Hans: 在空中飞行以击中目标的武器。
entries.es: Armas que vuelan por el aire para alcanzar un objetivo.
entries.pt-BR: Armas que voam pelo ar para atingir um alvo.
